original_ai_output.title_zh: 奥巴塞基哀悼贝宁火灾遇难者，呼吁加强安全措施
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚埃多州前州长戈德温·奥巴塞基对周四贝宁发生的火灾表示深切关注，该火灾造成人员死亡。他将奥卢库市场火灾描述为“悲剧且本可避免”，并呼吁严格执行安全法规、强化应急响应机制。据尼日利亚通讯社报道，事故起因是一辆油罐车翻倒后发生爆炸并引发火灾，造成人员伤亡和财产损失。

key_facts.fact: 埃多州前州长奥巴塞基对贝宁火灾遇难者表示哀悼
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Former Edo governor Godwin Obaseki on Friday expressed deep concern over the fire incident that claimed lives in Benin on Thursday.

key_facts.fact: 火灾发生在奥卢库市场，造成人员死亡和财产损失
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: he described the Oluku market fire as saddening

key_facts.fact: 据尼日利亚通讯社报道，事故起因是油罐车翻倒后爆炸起火
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The News Agency of Nigeria (NAN) reports that the incident occurred after a petrol tanker fell, leading to an explosion and subsequent fire that claimed lives and destroyed property.

key_facts.fact: 奥巴塞基呼吁严格执行安全法规并强化应急响应机制
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The former governor called for effective emergency response mechanisms, strict enforcement of safety regulations and decisive action

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（尼日利亚通讯社）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
